subject: [PATCH v5 10/19] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a helper function called khugepaged_full_pass() to the hugepage_settings module in selftests/mm. The function is used to wait for a full pass of khugepaged, which is necessary to distinguish between 'not collapsed' and 'not scanned yet' states in khugepaged tests. It uses sysfs to wake up the khugepaged daemon and waits until it completes one pass. The patch also modifies thp_write_settings() to write khugepaged settings only when their values change, preventing new passes from starting. This is necessary because a store to either sleep knob wakes up the daemon, causing it to start a new pass if the pages_to_scan value covers every mm on the list.
